abstract: A myeloproliferative condition in blastic phase is described in an 18-year-old male who was also found to have a mediastinal malignant teratoma. Myeloid metaplasia was found in the lymph nodes and spleen, and an infiltration of granulocytic blast cells was observed in the bone marrow and the lymph nodes. Aneuploidy with an extra chromosome (trisomy 8) was present in bone marrow cells. To our knowledge the combination of a myeloproliferative disorder and a malignant teratoma has not been earlier described.
abstract_ja: 18歳男性において、芽球期の骨髄増殖性症候群と縦隔の悪性奇形腫の併存が認められた。リンパ節および脾臓に骨髄様化生が認められ、骨髄およびリンパ節には顆粒球系芽球の浸潤が観察された。骨髄細胞には8番染色体の余剰を伴う異数性（トリソミー8）が認められた。骨髄増殖性症候群と悪性奇形腫の併存はこれまで報告されていない。
